source: Schreiber C. & Moissenet F., 'A multimodal dataset of human gait at different walking speeds established on injury-free adult participants', Scientific Data 6:111 (2019); companion analysis: Moissenet F., Leboeuf F., Armand S., Scientific Reports 9:9510 (2019). Raw dataset figshare doi 10.6084/m9.figshare.7734767 (v8).
condition: C4 (spontaneous self-selected speed), level overground walking
angle_convention_note: Sagittal ankle angle, dorsiflexion positive [deg]. Computed from raw markers: shank axis = midpoint(R_FAL,R_TAM)->midpoint(R_FLE,R_FME), foot axis = R_FCC->R_FM2, both projected into the subject's sagittal (progression-vertical) plane; angle = 90 deg minus the angle between foot-forward and shank-up axes. Zero is anchored per subject at their quiet-standing static trial (*_ST.c3d, per-subject offset subtracted; offsets mean 8.7 deg, sd 2.8). Cycle = right Foot Strike1 -> Foot Strike2 (dataset-provided events), 101 points. Averaged over trials within subject, then across the 48 subjects with valid data (of 50; 231 C4 trials, 215 used - rejections: foot not cleanly on a forceplate 9, missing lower-limb markers 7).
moment_convention_note: Internal sagittal ankle moment, plantarflexor positive [N.m/kg], normalized by each subject's body mass (c3d SUBJECT:weight). Quasi-static inverse dynamics on the foot segment: M_int = -[(COP - ankle_joint_centre) x F_grf + T_free], sagittal component taken about the subject-left horizontal axis (positive = plantarflexor for the right ankle by right-hand rule). Forceplate force/COP/free moment from c3d force-platform data (ezc3d extraction, inertial frame, N / mm / N.mm). Foot-segment inertial terms neglected, so swing-phase moment is set to 0 (true swing dorsiflexor moment is ~0.01-0.05 N.m/kg). Plate assigned to the right foot by COP proximity to the ankle at mid-stance; trials whose plate covered <70% of right stance rejected.
extraction_note: Extracted 2026-08-13 from raw c3d files (231 C4 trials + 50 static trials) with ezc3d 1.7.2; script refs/human_gait/moissenet2019/process_moissenet.py, per-subject static offsets refs/human_gait/moissenet2019/static_offsets.json. Markers 100 Hz, analog/forceplates 1500 Hz. Sanity stats: peak plantarflexor moment 1.23 N.m/kg at 49% cycle, peak dorsiflexion +9.8 deg (~50%), peak plantarflexion -17.0 deg (~65%), all within published normative ranges for self-selected-speed walking. The dataset itself ships no precomputed joint angles/moments; all curves here are computed from the raw markers, forceplate signals and gait events stored in the c3d files.
